purpose: Correct legacy29 protocol mismatch using published primary kernels and explicit intercept
interpretation: Same legacy cohort, different phenotyping experiment; not a new fully independent discovery. MAE/RMSE in raw days are cross-protocol, uncalibrated.

model_roles.mix_0.5_exploratory: fixed exploratory comparator, NOT externally optimized

frozen_protocol.selection: train83 only; pooled OOF MSE; KFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0); strict <
frozen_protocol.feature_convention: wholepanel83 mean/std(ddof=0) and kernel construction BEFORE inner slicing; NOT fully foldwise

ordering_validation.fallback: raw second-header ecotype ID -> full-panel column; arrays rebuilt and compared exactly
ordering_validation.block_allele_convention: original panel1307 minor coding; no recoding/scaling on external phenotypes

normalization_audit.source_semantics: kernel_utils.feature_kernel_centered_scaled: column mean/std ddof=0, epsilon=1e-8, Z@Z.T/p; no explicit H or trace step. All linear columns are variable here, so trace/83 is approximately 1 (float32 SNP). Gaussian uses primary.center_trace. Linear inference applies H/trace and lambda/scale, preserving primary regularization units, not silently changing the model. No feature stats include the 29 accessions.

inference.fisher: Pearson 95%, normal Fisher z with SE=1/sqrt(29-3)
inference.bootstrap: 10000 paired accession draws, common indices across all models, percentile 95%; conditional on frozen fit, not training uncertainty
inference.spearman_p: SciPy two-sided asymptotic p; small-n uncertainty also reported by paired bootstrap
inference.multiplicity: Nominal p and Holm across all four models x two correlation tests (8); no winner selection
